memory_update.text: AMKR should be retained as a reference anchor for US-listed advanced-packaging capacity, but not treated as the highest-edge underfollowed name without stronger evidence that AI/HBM packaging is becoming a material revenue and margin driver.
FORM is a high-priority underfollowed candidate for the HBM test layer because HBM growth pulls through DRAM probe-card demand and wafer-level known-good-die testing.

ONTO and CAMT form the inspection/metrology discovery pair for advanced packaging and HBM; later layers should compare customer concentration, tool-of-record status, order durability, and revenue purity.

This pass did not fully cover materials and consumables such as temporary bonding/debonding chemicals, substrates, thermal interface materials, underfill, ABF-like build-up films, or test sockets; run a separate pass focused on specialty materials and consumables.

node: HBM and advanced-packaging inputs below the memory producers
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around scarce HBM and advanced-packaging inputs, emphasizing companies one layer below memory producers and foundries: OSAT advanced packaging capacity, HBM probe cards, inspection/metrology, and heterogeneous-packaging process control. The list intentionally avoids filling with mega-cap memory/foundry leaders. AMKR is included mainly as a reference/context anchor because it is the most visible US-listed advanced-packaging OSAT; FORM, ONTO, and CAMT are the underfollowed discovery lane. Market caps were checked on 2026-06-12; all four are above USD 1B, with CAMT closest to the preferred mid-cap range.
